name: AI Organ Archive
notes: Reads organ source as inert bytes, derives provenance-labelled part cards, and preserves immutable content-addressed versions. A normal persistent Mirror runtime automatically performs a catch-up scan and watches for later organ changes in the same Node process; stopping Mirror stops the watcher. An inferred, non-exclusive purpose taxonomy adds one browsing shelf plus multiple use fields and functional roles without granting semantic or compatibility authority. The explicit portable export contains only current public organ source and bounded metadata, stores every source once, and excludes private state, historical versions, receipts, checkpoints, logs, tokens, and specialist memory. An explicit separate intake may copy one Workshop Verification Spine report into private immutable evidence after independently reproducing its category aggregates, contradictions, holds and verdict; categories are never averaged. An explicit dormant component projector converts the current catalog into content-addressed static component data with exact declared-schema ports, exact local-organ dependency references, unknown resource fields, separate verification ceilings, unmatched inputs, and unconsumed outputs. V2 specialist generation identities bind the composition algorithm plus generation, component, projection, graph, and dependency-closure protocols, so a protocol change creates a new immutable generation instead of colliding with an earlier result. Specialist generations carry graph assessments but remain unassembled. Archived organs, exports, labels, external reports, component records, graphs, and specialist plans never gain load, execution, connection, permission, promotion, return-to-Mirror, or runtime authority.
